questionText:
Consider the following C function definition.

Which of the following statements is/are TRUE about the above function?
options: If the inputs are $x=20$, $y=10$, then the return value is greater than $2^{20}$
If the inputs are $x=20$, $y=20$, then the return value is greater than $2^{20}$
If the inputs are $x=20$, $y=10$, then the return value is less than $2^{10}$
If the inputs are $x=10$, $y=20$, then the return value is greater than $2^{20}$
explanation:
Step 1: Analyze the recurrence relation in the loop
In each iteration of the loop, the value of $x$ is updated as:
$$x_{\text{new}} = x + x + y = 2x + y$$

Step 2: Derive the closed-form expression
Starting with initial value $x_0 = x$, after $y$ iterations:
• Iteration 1: $x_1 = 2x + y$
• Iteration 2: $x_2 = 2(2x + y) + y = 2^2 x + y(2 + 1)$
• Iteration $y$: $x_y = 2^y x + y(2^{y-1} + 2^{y-2} + \dots + 1) = 2^y x + y(2^y - 1)$

Step 3: Evaluate each option

• Option A & Option C ($x = 20, y = 10$):
$$\text{Return value} = 2^{10}(20) + 10(2^{10} - 1) = 20 \cdot 1024 + 10(1023) = 30710$$
Since $30710 < 2^{20}$ and $30710 > 2^{10}$, Statement (A) and Statement (C) are both FALSE.

• Option B ($x = 20, y = 20$):
$$\text{Return value} = 2^{20}(20) + 20(2^{20} - 1) = 40 \cdot 2^{20} - 20$$
Since $40 \cdot 2^{20} - 20 > 2^{20}$, Statement (B) is TRUE.

• Option D ($x = 10, y = 20$):
$$\text{Return value} = 2^{20}(10) + 20(2^{20} - 1) = 30 \cdot 2^{20} - 20$$
Since $30 \cdot 2^{20} - 20 > 2^{20}$, Statement (D) is TRUE.

Hence, options (B) and (D) are the correct answers.
